why_not_a_full_pass: The race detector was never executed. An environment block is NOT evidence that the project has no data races.
SM2 key agreement still has no independent implementation cross-check.
Even with suite 2 live, this is NOT a post-quantum system: SM2 identity authentication is not post-quantum. Suite 2 only makes the session key depend on both an SM2 and an ML-KEM-768 secret.
what_is_verified: go test real exit code 0; 14 expected packages; 180 top-level and 186 subtests pass; 0 failures.
The strict summarizer certifies the run as PASS with the real exit code supplied.
Summarizer self-test: 17 cases plus the M2NEG extraction guard.
37 structured negative cases, distributed across message_sequence_or_encoding (16), signature_authentication (10), identity_or_key_binding (7), finished_confirmation (3) and suite_policy (1).
10 wire-level attack cases: 9 downgrade scenarios plus the implicit-rejection case.
Suite 2 E2E: PASS, 26/26; the session id is per-run and is recorded only in results/raw/m3_hybrid_e2e_summary.json (field session_id), never copied by hand.
Suite 1 E2E: PASS, 26/26; the session id is per-run and is recorded only in results/raw/m2_e2e_summary.json (field session_id), never copied by hand.
recorded_limitations: Reuse of an ML-KEM encapsulation key across sessions is NOT detectable by the responder; only degenerate cases such as an all-zero key are caught.
The control message still only updates a parameter value; no timer drives periodic sampling at that interval.
A repeated operation_id with different parameters returns Duplicate=true and does not change the applied value; this is the pinned contract, not a rewritten semantic.
Exactly-once delivery across restarts is not implemented.
may_proceed_note: M3 is complete and the gate was opened only after every stated condition passed. The two verification gaps must be closed before any deployment or any claim of complete verification.
must_not_be_reported_as: a security audit or compliance certification
